hints.text: This clue is a double definition. Most clues have a single definition (and the rest of the clue functions as letterplay and wordplay), but in a double definition you split the clue in two and each part functions as a definition for the answer. So, our answer will somehow represent 'Christmas', and the question mark on the end of the clue suggests that this might be a slightly stretchy definition.
